_note: One row per release component. A later feature job adds its row (and its licence entries) instead of new packaging work. Every installed file is owned by exactly one component; the builder fails on a file no component owns. source kinds: dll (the CI-built proxy), dxvk_dll, dxvk_license (pinned by core/proxy/tools/fetch_dxvk.py), player_ini (generated from registries/config_keys.jsonl), repo:<path>, text:<key> (from this row's texts), external:<name>:<file> (a build output outside the repo, sha256-checked against <file>.json).
